Built for athletes who train hard and still need to move free.

The American Flag Athletic Shorts are King Killers fightwear energy for the gym, fight camp, and street. Lightweight two-way stretch fabric keeps you mobile through bag work, open mat, and conditioning — without bagging out after one session.

Why fighters grab these

  • Athletic cut that stops just above the knee for coverage without drag
  • Two-way stretch fabric that moves with hips and knees
  • Side pockets for phone/keys when you leave the gym
  • Bold American flag graphic that reads fight-fan, not boardroom
  • Pairs with King Killers tees, rash guards, and walkout layers
